title: Water is the source of life
intro: Water is one of the greatest mercies of Allah.

learn.html: Water is one of the greatest mercies of Allah. In the Qur’an Allah tells us that He made every living thing from water.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html:
Allah says that from water He made every living thing. (Qur’an, Al-Anbiya 21:30)
That is why we say: water is the source of life.

items.label: About 70 out of every 100 parts of our body are water
Water covers more than two thirds of the Earth
Water goes round and round: sea → cloud → rain → river → sea
People, animals and plants all need water to live

learn.title: 🫧 Clean and cleaning
learn.html: Allah made water clean, and it also makes things clean. It washes away the dirt we can see and the germs we cannot see. It also helps us relax and get ready for salah. That is why we wash with water (wudu) and bathe regularly.
Muhammad (SAW) said: “The best water on the face of the Earth is Zamzam. In it there is food for the hungry and a cure for the sick.” (Tabarani, Ibn Hibban)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: There is only a little drinking water, so let’s save water and protect life on Earth! Let’s think about the blessing of water and be thankful to our Lord – say Alhamdulillah after you drink.

practice.title: How can we save water?
practice.prompt: Tap every way to save water, then tap Check.

options.text: 🚰 Turn off the tap while brushing our teeth
🥤 Drink all the water we pour into our glass
🔧 Tell an adult when a tap is dripping
🤲 Use just enough water for wudu
💦 Leave the tap running while we play
options.why: That wastes water – and drinking water is precious.

options.text: 🛁 Fill the bath and then pour it away without using it
options.why: That wastes a lot of water we could have saved.

practice.title: The water cycle
practice.prompt: Put the journey of water in order, starting with the sea.
items: ☀️ The sun warms it and it rises up
🏞️ It flows in rivers back to the sea
